summary.oneLiner: ISO-certified technology company providing end-to-end digital commerce enablement, ONDC integration, and software solutions to clients across 12+ countries.
summary.business: ENS Enterprises is an ISO 27001:2022 and ISO 9001:2015 certified technology company established in 2016 and headquartered in Uttar Pradesh, offering e-commerce development, ONDC integration, custom software, mobile apps, cloud/DevOps, digital marketing and proprietary SaaS products. It serves corporates, SMEs and government-backed initiatives in India and internationally (US, Japan, Singapore, UK, Canada) through a hybrid revenue model combining one-time project fees with recurring SaaS/retainer income.
